parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the connection tracking support for the IRC protocol (IRC ALG).

parameters.name: Ports
parameters.description: Port numbers of the IRC servers that need to be monitored.

parameters.name: MAXDCCChannels
parameters.description: Maximum number of Direct Client-to-Client (DCC) channels allowed per IRC session.

parameters.name: DCCTimeout
parameters.description: Timeout duration for unestablished Direct Client-to-Client (DCC) channels.
